caption:
Uganda says it will withdraw troops from DR Congo town of Lubero

Army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of President Yoweri Museveni, had threatened days earlier to take control of Walikale. Uganda's army announced the withdrawal plan on Friday. Lubero and Walikale are both in North Kivu, and the threat led to a diplomatic spat between the neighboring countries.

Reported by France 24; BBC; Africanews.
